product: PayPal connector is available in Beta
tagline: The managed PayPal connector is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect.
what_it_does: The managed PayPal connector is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect. Use the connector to ingest payments data such as transactions, disputes, invoices, balances, catalog products, and billing plans from PayPal into Databricks. The connector uses OAuth client credentials and supports incremental ingestion.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
